newsitem.title: INDIA: India to decide on oil price hike on June 15.
newsitem.headline: India to decide on oil price hike on June 15.

text.p: Indian Prime Minister I. K. Gujral said on Tuesday that a final decision on an increase in oil product prices would be taken on June 15 by the ruling United Front's steering committee, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.

"The issue of increase in prices of petroleum products will be decided finally at the steering committee meeting on June 15," PTI quoted Gujral as telling reporters after the induction of four ministers into his cabinet.

Strong opposition from left-wing constituents of the United Front had prevented the steering committee from arriving at a consensus on raising the prices of oil products at its last meeting on May 25.
Gujral said on Tuesday he would stick to his stand of evolving a consensus among various political parties on the issue of increasing petroleum product prices.
"I would rather evolve a consensus in my delayed style rather than announce any decision and face agitation on the streets," PTI quoted him as saying.
